title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King
description: As a cultivation genius who has achieved a new realm every two years since he was a year old, Wang Ling is a near-invincible existence with prowess far beyond his control. But now that he’s sixteen, he faces his greatest battle yet – Senior High School. With one challenge after another popping up, his plans for a low-key high school life seem further and further away…

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Wang Ling is  rookie at the Songhai School. With only 5 points of spiritual strength, he will have to face some problems.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Sun Rong and Chen Chao compete for the position of student president of the elite class. Will Sun Rong be able to pull it off with an enchantment?

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: In  the elite class, students learn how to make vitality pulls. Although the others use wacky ovens or cauldrons, Wang Ling decides to use a microwave.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Sun Rong asks Wang Ling out on a special date. But what she doesn't know is that two killers will try to spoil her fun.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: The killers return to attack the school. But this time the school is prepared to face any threat. However, the attack of the three brothers is too powerful.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Wang Ling comes out first in the national power test and decides to infiltrate the system to change his score.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Wang Ling will participate in the interschool sword competition with his friends against his rival, the 59th school.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Wang Ling doesn't want to participate in the competition and looks for the perfect moment to pretend to feel bad. When his amulet is about to break, Wang Ling's health is in danger of seriously deteriorating.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Wang Ling needs his father to come to his aid or disaster is imminent. While he waits, Wang Ling runs into a dangerous female leader in the halls of School 59.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: The amulet is broken and now Wang Ling must control his emotions on his own. Meanwhile, Sun Rong is ready to help her most important friend.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Wang Ling tries to keep a low profile now that his amulet is broken. At the Water Alter, Sun Rong confronts Tang Jingze.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: As Wang Ling begins to lose control, Toad jumps on top of him and absorbs his negative energy. At that moment, something amazing happens that gives Wang Ling the ability to use his strength without restraint from him.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Tang Jingze's spirit sword engages Sun Rong and destroys his weapon. Wang Ling's father implores them to stop the competition before someone gets hurt.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: The competition comes to an end. The leader of the League of Shadows attacks and Wang Ling finally loses control.

episodes_data.title: The Daily Life of the Immortal King Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Wang Ling quickly realizes his mistake: not having stopped the leader of the League of Shadows sooner, so he decides to take the risk once more.
